components.name: Browser Launch Link
components.description: The squared sand action used in the landing hero, header, and closing photograph.
components.html: Open OpenFilm
components.css: .ds-launch { align-items: center; background: var(--color-accent); border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-ink); display: inline-flex; font: 600 0.8rem/1 var(--font-body); gap: 2.2rem; min-height: 3.2rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem 0.75rem 1.05rem; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-launch svg { stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; width: 1.15rem; } .ds-launch:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-launch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The sand workstation action for opening a folder or confirming a focused task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--color-accent-ink); font: 500 var(--type-body)/1 var(--font-body); min-height: 2.6rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workstation Proof Frame
components.description: Fine-rule documentary chrome around a real workstation screenshot.
components.css: .ds-proof { background: var(--color-paper); border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); box-shadow: 0 2rem 5rem rgb(0 0 0 / 48%); color: var(--color-ink); margin: 0; } .ds-proof-bar { background: #0b0b0b; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); color: var(--color-muted); font: 500 0.58rem/2rem var(--font-body); letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 0 0.75rem; text-align: right; } .ds-proof-image { align-items: center; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; display: flex; justify-content: center; }

narrative.overview: OpenFilm is primarily a working surface. Near-black chrome, warm-white type, fine rules, and one restrained sand signal frame the Source photograph. The landing page uses the same world at editorial scale, with real workstation proof, full-bleed photography, and factual product language.
keyCharacteristics: Matte near-black chrome, warm-white type, fine rules, and a restrained sand signal.
OpenFilm Bodoni display paired with Helvetica Neue interface copy and tabular numeric values.
Photograph-first proof through real workstation screenshots and grounded photographic assets.
Local-first language with no ornamental claims, social proof, or cloud and account theatre.

rules.name: The Photograph-First Rule
rules.body: Give the image the largest uninterrupted region available. Copy, navigation, and controls frame the proof; they do not compete with it.

rules.name: The Single Reveal Rule
rules.body: The landing hero may stage one vertical workstation entrance when motion is allowed; reduced motion removes it rather than replacing it with another effect.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Sand is a functional signal for action, focus, Selection, and direct manipulation, not a decorative wash; status colors remain status-only.

rules.name: The Matte Layer Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces by value before reaching for a shadow; use elevation only when an element overlaps content or needs a clear state response.

rules.name: The Local Fact Rule
rules.body: Every landing-page claim must be traceable to the shipped workstation or its documented browser boundary; atmosphere never stands in for evidence.

dos: Do make a real photograph the strongest object in the landing first viewport, workstation proof, and final CTA.
Do keep the near-black ground, warm-white type, fine rules, OpenFilm Bodoni display, and one restrained sand interaction signal across workstation and landing surfaces.
Do make local behavior, Library durability, recovery, and export language plain and visible.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and browser launch links explicitly named.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass effects, blur-backed panels, ornamental dashboards, fake metrics, testimonials, account or cloud claims, or a second accent family.
Don't replace the OpenFilm wordmark with the old OF monogram or redesign the workstation as marketing UI.
Don't imply archival fidelity, universal performance, automatic quality judgment, or Source backup beyond the recorded product behavior.
Don't turn every landing section into a rounded card or place a wide shadow beneath a rule by default.
